lb-1brq.title: Fix Epic CLI args not distinguishing explicit vs default values
lb-1brq.description: Epic command uses default_value_t for timeout/max_failures then checks if value \!= default to decide whether to use config. This means passing --timeout 15 explicitly is treated as 'use config'. Fix by using Option<u32> instead.

lb-1zh1.title: Add --model flag to loop and epic subcommands
lb-1zh1.description: The run command has --model to override the configured model, but loop and epic don't expose this flag.

lb-2095.title: mrmouth summary starts TUI but routes output to raw stderr, hiding all output
lb-2095.description: When 'mrmouth summary' is run on a TTY, TuiHandle::try_start() enters alternate screen mode on stderr. However, summary::execute is called with logger=None (main.rs), so run_streaming_claude uses StreamTarget::Stderr and all formatted output goes via eprintln\! to raw stderr. In alternate screen mode this output is hidden/overwritten by TUI redraws, making summary output invisible. Fix: either (a) pass tui.as_ref() into summary::execute and add TUI routing there, or (b) skip TUI startup for the summary subcommand (add it to the use_raw check).

lb-2dra.title: Create src/tui.rs: TuiHandle, TuiSender, multi-pane render thread
lb-2dra.description:
New file src/tui.rs implementing:

Public API:
  pub struct TuiHandle  // owns background render thread; Drop → shutdown
  pub struct TuiSender { label: String, tx: Sender<TuiMsg> }

  impl TuiHandle {
      pub fn try_start() -> Option<Self>   // None if stderr is not TTY
      pub fn sender(&self, label: &str) -> TuiSender
  }
  impl Drop for TuiHandle { fn drop(&mut self) { /* send Quit, join thread */ } }

  impl TuiSender {
      pub fn send_line(&self, line: String)
      pub fn with_label(&self, label: &str) -> Self  // clone with different pane label
  }

Internal:
  enum TuiMsg { Line { pane: String, text: String }, Quit }
  struct TuiState { panes: IndexMap<String, VecDeque<String>>, active: String, max_lines: usize /* 500 */ }

Layout:
  ┌───────────────────────────────────────────┐
  │ mrmouth │ AGENT SESSION │ branch=feat-foo  │  ← header: active pane label
  ├───────────────────────────────────────────┤
  │ [text]                                    │
  │     I'll start by reading...              │  ← scrolling ring buffer
  │ [Bash]                                    │
  │     lb list                               │
  │ [1/3]  Tab=next  q=quit                  │  ← footer (only if >1 pane)
  └───────────────────────────────────────────┘

Render thread: crossterm alternate screen mode. Loop: recv() on mpsc::Receiver<TuiMsg> + crossterm::event::poll(50ms) for keyboard. Redraws on each event.

Keyboard: Tab cycles panes, q/Ctrl-C sends SIGTERM or process::exit(0) after terminal restore.

ANSI: use ansi-to-tui crate to convert ANSI strings from stream_fmt.rs to ratatui Text/Lines/Spans.

Shutdown: Drop sends Quit, joins thread. Cleanup: disable_raw_mode() + LeaveAlternateScreen.

lb-34j5.title: Fix runner script missing lb sync after init
lb-34j5.description: The runner entrypoint script in run.rs initializes litebrite (lb init, lb setup claude) but never calls lb sync to pull the latest task state. The agent starts with stale state. Add lb sync after lb setup claude in the runner script.

lb-3hsl.title: Add --rm flag to docker run for automatic container cleanup
lb-3hsl.description: The docker run command in docker.rs doesn't use --rm. While there's manual cleanup via remove_container(), adding --rm would provide automatic cleanup if the host process crashes or is killed before cleanup runs.

lb-4nvs.title: loop_cmd.rs uses raw eprintln bypassing TUI routing
lb-4nvs.description: Same issue as lb-pmal but in src/loop_cmd.rs: ~12 direct eprintln! calls for bootstrap messages, loop status, and delay notifications bypass the TUI when it is active. Should route through a TuiSender like epic.rs now does.

lb-5amv.title: Fix stream_fmt result text not indented
lb-5amv.description: In stream_fmt.rs, tool result text uses collapsed directly without indent(), while error results use indent(&collapsed). This makes result output misaligned.

lb-5yis.title: Modify src/summary.rs: switch to stream-json, use streaming helper
lb-5yis.description:
Currently summary uses no --output-format flag (defaults to plain text stdout). The summary text appears but the agent's tool calls (Read, Write) are invisible.

Changes:
1. Add --output-format stream-json to the claude CLI args.
2. Also add --allowedTools to include Read,Write (already there).
3. Replace manual stdout/stderr tee with run_streaming_claude(child, &mut formatter, logger).
4. The summary text still gets written to the summary file (agent does this via Write tool).
5. Remove existing tee_stdout and tee_stderr calls.

Result: SUMMARY pane shows agent reading the JSONL log, writing the summary, and final output — all formatted with colors just like the main agent session.

lb-60qe.title: Sub-agent formatter hardcodes is_tty=true, pollutes non-TTY output with ANSI codes
lb-60qe.description: In streaming.rs callers (reviewer.rs, shipper.rs, summary.rs, loop_cmd.rs), StreamFormatter::new(true) is always called regardless of whether stderr is a TTY. This means ANSI escape codes are embedded in output even in non-TTY environments (CI, piped logs). The main agent formatter in run.rs correctly checks stdout.is_terminal(). The fix: in run_streaming_claude or its callers, use io::stderr().is_terminal() || logger.has_tui() to decide is_tty.

lb-68yw.title: Modify src/epic.rs: thread TUI into run::execute calls
lb-68yw.description: Add tui: Option<&TuiHandle> parameter to epic::execute(). Forward to each run::execute() call within the epic loop. No other changes needed — the TUI pane label 'AGENT SESSION' will be reused across iterations (each iteration overwrites the previous content in the same pane, or could append — either is acceptable for v1).

lb-95nz.title: Fix loop decider allowed tools to include lb commands
lb-95nz.description: The decider prompt says to check litebrite state but only allows Read and Bash(git *). Needs Bash(lb *) too.

lb-9lnz.title: Modify src/logger.rs: add TUI routing

lb-anmx.title: Create src/shipper.rs
lb-anmx.description: New host-side agent. ShipperOptions { model, current_branch, parent_branch }. ShipResult { new_branch }. Steps: (1) run_shipper_agent checks lb list -s open and runs tests, returns READY/BLOCKED via JSON; (2) merge_branch: file-remote=git merge --no-ff, github=gh pr create + gh pr merge; (3) generate_branch_name asks claude to read SPEC.md for 2-4 word kebab name, formats as feat-{slug}, fallback feat-{timestamp}; (4) create_and_push_branch: git checkout -b, push -u origin if github remote. Also exports create_and_push_branch and generate_branch_name as pub for use by loop_cmd.

lb-cmnc.title: Add Ratatui TUI with streaming output to mrmouth
lb-cmnc.description: Add a Ratatui TUI that shows streaming agent output in named panes (one per stage), with a header indicating the active stage and Tab-based pane switching for concurrent stages. Replace all terminal output with TUI-routed versions when running in a TTY. Also fix reviewer, summary, decider, and shipper to use --output-format stream-json so their work is visible (not just stderr chatter).

lb-cqhc.title: Modify src/reviewer.rs: switch to stream-json, use streaming helper
lb-cqhc.description:
Currently reviewer uses --output-format json; its thinking/tool calls/text are invisible (only stderr chatter shown).

Changes:
1. Add --output-format stream-json to the claude CLI args (remove --output-format json if present; reviewer didn't have it explicitly, verify).
2. Replace the manual stdout/stderr tee with run_streaming_claude(child, &mut formatter, logger).
3. The reviewer doesn't need structured output — just success/failure — so ignore the returned result string.
4. Remove the existing tee_stdout call (no longer needed).

Result: users see the reviewer's thinking, what it reads (git diff, git log), what lb commands it runs, and its final assessment — all in the CODE REVIEW pane.

lb-eivs.title: Modify src/loop_cmd.rs: thread TUI, per-stage labels for concurrent stages

lb-glnx.title: StreamFormatter created with is_tty=false for TUI targets in streaming.rs
lb-glnx.description: In src/streaming.rs, run_streaming_claude callers create StreamFormatter::new(logger.map_or(true, |l| !l.has_tui())). When TUI is active (has_tui()=true), this evaluates to is_tty=false, stripping all ANSI color codes. But the TUI uses ansi_to_tui to render ANSI-coded text, so it CAN display colors. The result is that reviewer, decider, shipper, and summary sub-agent output shows in the TUI without any colors. The flag should be true when the target is a TUI pane.

lb-h5wx.title: Add branch field to RunOptions
lb-h5wx.description: src/run.rs: add 'pub branch: Option<String>' to RunOptions. Update branch resolution to check opts.branch first, then config.branch, then git current branch, then main. Add branch: None to callers in main.rs and epic.rs.

lb-hwg3.title: Reviewer, Shipper, and Branch-per-Feature
lb-hwg3.description: Add reviewer and shipper agents to mrmouth loop, plus branch-per-feature management. Workers always work on a feature branch; reviewer runs after each worker pass; decider gains ship action; shipper handles merging and creates next branch.

lb-l78i.title: Update loop_cmd: Decision enum, decider schema, branch management
lb-l78i.description: Decision enum: add Ship variant. Decider JSON schema: change from {continue:bool} to {action: continue|ship|stop, reason}. Update should_continue to parse action field. execute(): capture parent_branch before feature branch creation; bootstrap mode stays on main (no branch created); otherwise call shipper::generate_branch_name + create_and_push_branch; track current_branch as mutable; pass branch: Some(current_branch) to RunOptions; run reviewer after litebrite::sync (serial, before decider); handle Ship decision by calling shipper::execute and updating current_branch. Add BranchCreation variant to LoopError. Add git_current_branch helper.

lb-ljfl.title: Add --init flag to docker run to reap zombie processes
lb-ljfl.description: Docker containers without --init don't have a proper init process (PID 1). If the agent spawns background processes that die, they become zombies. The --init flag adds tini as PID 1 to properly reap them.

lb-m12l.title: Register modules in main.rs
lb-m12l.description: Add 'mod reviewer;' and 'mod shipper;' to main.rs. Add branch: None to RunOptions construction in Commands::Run arm.

lb-o0x7.title: mrmouth summary standalone command now outputs to stderr instead of stdout (spec deviation)
lb-o0x7.description: SPEC.md says: 'Print summary to stdout'. Before this branch, summary.rs used tee_stdout (println\!) to display Claude output. After this branch, it uses StreamTarget::Stderr -> eprintln\!. Anyone piping 'mrmouth summary > file.md' now gets an empty file. Fix: for the standalone summary command, either use StreamTarget::Stdout (add a new variant) or keep using println\! for the summary command path.

lb-okra.title: Modify src/run.rs: wire TUI into agent session streaming

lb-oskn.title: Fix Dockerfile cross-platform support for ARM/aarch64
lb-oskn.description: The DEFAULT_DOCKERFILE hardcodes x86_64-unknown-linux-musl for the litebrite build stage. This fails on ARM machines (Apple Silicon Macs). Should detect architecture dynamically.

lb-pmal.title: epic.rs uses raw eprintln bypassing TUI routing
lb-pmal.description: src/epic.rs has ~12 direct eprintln! calls throughout execute(). When TUI is active, stderr is in alternate screen mode (crossterm EnterAlternateScreen). Raw eprintln to stderr in this mode either corrupts TUI rendering or produces invisible output. epic.rs needs to receive a Logger or TuiHandle and route all its status output through it.

lb-q88t.title: Add ratatui, crossterm, ansi-to-tui to Cargo.toml
lb-q88t.description:
Add dependencies to Cargo.toml:
  ratatui = "0.29"
  crossterm = "0.28"
  ansi-to-tui = "4"

These are needed for the TUI implementation. ansi-to-tui converts ANSI-colored strings from stream_fmt.rs into ratatui Span structures so colors are preserved in the TUI.

lb-si5j.title: Add GitHub Actions release workflow
lb-si5j.description: The spec mentions distributing via GitHub releases with prebuilt binaries for Linux and macOS (x86_64, aarch64). Add a release.yml workflow triggered on tag push that cross-compiles and publishes binaries.

lb-tso7.title: Create src/reviewer.rs
lb-tso7.description: New host-side claude agent. Mirrors summary.rs pattern. ReviewerOptions { model, current_branch }. Allowed tools: Read,Bash(git diff *),Bash(git log *),Bash(lb *). Prompt: review changes on current_branch vs SPEC.md using git diff/log, create brites for issues (lb create), mark done items (lb close). Single pass. Non-fatal at call site.

lb-u9z2.title: Extract run_streaming_claude helper for shared streaming logic
lb-u9z2.description:
Create a shared helper (in src/agent.rs or as a private module-level function) for running a claude CLI subprocess with --output-format stream-json and routing output to a Logger/TUI pane.

Signature:
  fn run_streaming_claude(
      child: Child,
      formatter: &mut StreamFormatter,
      logger: Option<&Logger>,
  ) -> Result<String, io::Error>
  // Returns: content of the final 'result' event (for structured output parsing)

Implementation:
  1. Tee child.stderr via logger.tee_stderr()
  2. Read stdout JSONL line by line
  3. For each line: route through stream_fmt::format_line() → logger.display()
  4. Collect lines; find the event where type=="result", return its "result" field value
  5. Wait for child exit, check status

This avoids duplication across reviewer, summary, decider, shipper. The returned result string is parsed as JSON by callers that need structured output (decider, check_ready, generate_branch_name). Callers that don't need structured output (reviewer) ignore the return value.

lb-uaey.title: Modify src/shipper.rs: switch check_ready and generate_branch_name to stream-json
lb-uaey.description:
Currently check_ready and generate_branch_name use --output-format json --json-schema ...; their reasoning is invisible.

Changes in check_ready():
1. Keep --json-schema schema.
2. Change --output-format to stream-json.
3. Replace wait_with_output() + manual tee with run_streaming_claude(child, &mut formatter, logger).
4. Parse status/reason from returned result string:
   let result_json: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(&result_text)?;
   let status = result_json["status"].as_str()...;

Changes in generate_branch_name():
1. Same pattern: stream-json, streaming helper, parse branch name from result string.
2. The fallback (timestamp-based name) stays for error cases.

Note: shipper also uses logger parameter already, so the streaming helper integrates cleanly.

lb-uiox.title: Add reviewer_model and shipper_model to LoopConfig
lb-uiox.description: src/config.rs: add reviewer_model (default sonnet) and shipper_model (default sonnet) to LoopConfig struct and its Default impl. Update full_config_parses test.

lb-vsce.title: Modify src/main.rs: start TUI, thread into subcommands
lb-vsce.description:
In main():
1. After config loading, check if stderr is TTY and --raw not set:
   let tui = if !raw { tui::TuiHandle::try_start() } else { None };

2. Thread Option<&TuiHandle> into each subcommand:
   - run::execute(&config, &repo_root, opts, tui.as_ref())
   - loop_cmd::execute(&config, &repo_root, opts, tui.as_ref())
   - epic::execute(&config, &repo_root, opts, tui.as_ref())
   - summary::execute() doesn't need TUI (standalone command)

3. TuiHandle drops at end of main() → clean terminal restore.

The 'raw' flag for mrmouth run disables TUI. Non-TTY contexts (pipes, CI) also disable it via try_start() returning None.

lb-xfzy.title: TUI q/Ctrl+C exits via process::exit bypassing Docker cleanup
lb-xfzy.description: In src/tui.rs render_loop(), pressing q or Ctrl+C calls std::process::exit(0) after cleanup_terminal(). This bypasses all cleanup in the main thread: running Docker containers are not stopped (orphan containers), litebrite state is not synced, and any other cleanup code (git pulls, etc.) is skipped. Should send a cancellation signal to the main thread instead of calling process::exit.

lb-y354.title: Add unit tests for run.rs helper functions
lb-y354.description: run.rs has testable helper functions (preflight checks, git_remote_url, configure_file_remote, git_current_branch, write_runner_script) that lack tests. Add unit tests for these.

lb-yzzv.title: Modify loop_cmd.rs::should_continue: switch decider to stream-json
